fork_status_and_schedule.highlight: Glamsterdam devnet-9 (non-finality stress test, ~4 days) launches once all clients merge trunk branches
Sep 28 proposed for Sepolia fork, Oct 26 for Hoodi; ~30-day security window targets mainnet by early December

glamsterdam_updates.highlight: History expiry: all clients aligned on CL block retention window (~33,000 epochs); Nethermind, Nimbus, Reth ready; Geth, Erigon, ethrex in progress
EIP-8037 gas refill for SELFDESTRUCT rejected for Glamsterdam; too late, low current usage (~1,500 accounts/day); deferred to Hegota
eth_simulateV1 spec incomplete — clients disagree on simulated block contents; needs async resolution via execution-apis issue #868

eip_proposals_hegota.highlight: EIP-7609 (decrease TLOAD/TSTORE base cost) dropped — no champion present
EIP-8058 (bytecode deduplication discount) dropped — superseded by SETCODEFROM per Ben Adams
EIP-8360 (TCREATE opcode) kept as placeholder for ephemeral-contract solution replacing SELFDESTRUCT refill
EIP-8304 (Trustless Log Index): demo shown; proof sizes and speed better than expected; lightclient confirmed A-tier preference

account_abstraction.highlight: EIP-8141 (Frames) / EIP-8130 collaboration underway; two target outcomes: shared tx type, or account interoperability with two tx types
AA breakout moving to weekly cadence (Tuesdays 14:00 UTC) for ~1 month to accelerate convergence
ethrex (lambdaclass) flagged exclusion from private 8130/8141 collaboration chat; consensus that discussions should move to ETH R&D
EIP-8141 (Frames) SFI'd for Hegota; spec changes remain possible; SFI status must not block continued iteration

pq_readiness.highlight: Deposit contract PQ options: new contract, irregular state transition, or precompile/opcode; irregular STF more acceptable if bundled with PBT migration

action_items.action: Review and comment on eth_simulateV1 simulated-block spec gaps (execution-apis issue #868)
Champion ephemeral-contract / SELFDESTRUCT-replacement EIP for Hegota within 2-4 weeks or it will not be included
Submit Hegota client preferences to facilitators by Sep 9 (24 hours before next ACDE)

decisions.decision: EIP-8037 SELFDESTRUCT gas refill not added to Glamsterdam; deferred to Hegota with proper EIP
DFI for Hegota: EIP-7609 (TLOAD/TSTORE cost decrease), EIP-8058 (bytecode deduplication discount) — no champion; EIP-8360 (TCREATE) retained as placeholder
EIP-8141 (Frames) SFI for Hegota; spec may still change; SFI status must not impede continued L2 collaboration or spec iteration

targets.target: Glamsterdam devnet-9 (non-finality) — launches as soon as all clients have trunk branches ready; runs ~4 days
Sepolia Glamsterdam fork — September 28, 2026 (pending ACDC confirmation)
Hoodi Glamsterdam fork — October 26, 2026 (pending ACDC confirmation)
Hegota scoping complete by DEVCON — November 3, 2026
